messages:
deploy-bot: [PROD] Deploy started by @sara — service: inference-api, tag: v1.4.2-hotfix, commit: 3a7f9c4, change window: now
sara: rolling this out to prod (3 replicas). health checks passing initially.
leo: noticed errors spiking on /v1/generate around 14:02 UTC, mostly 5xx and increased latency.
matt: can you confirm which change might cause that? quantization flags? memory?
sara: seeing OOMs on one of the p4d nodes in the live logs. halting further rollout and investigating.
leo: logs: ```
OOM killed process worker pid=2245 alloc failed
stack: ...
```
matt: agree we should rollback, priority is customer-facing stability.
sara: initiating rollback to v1.4.1-stable now — will pin routing and stop traffic to v1.4.2-hotfix.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for inference-api in prod by sara — target tag: v1.4.1-stable, commit: b9c6d2e. start_ts=2025-09-12T14:06:12Z
anika: pinned service -> v1.4.1-stable in service discovery and set traffic-split: 100% -> v1.4.1-stable, 0% -> v1.4.2-hotfix.
leo: confirming metrics now show error rate dropping. tailing logs show no new OOMs.
matt: creating a short changelog entry: "Reverted v1.4.2-hotfix due to worker memory regression. Rollback executed; investigating quantization change."
sara: scheduling a follow-up change window to reattempt a hotfix with debug off and lower batch-size. @karen can we do 09:00 PT tomorrow?
karen: yep. 30-min window reserved, infra on standby.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed for inference-api in prod — reverted to v1.4.1-stable (commit b9c6d2e). All instances healthy. completed_ts=2025-09-12T14:09:43Z :white_check_mark:
sara: thanks all. I'll file a short postmortem and assign next steps.
leo: opened INF-412 and attached heap profiles and the problematic config diff, tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml.
matt: also added a temporary pin in the deploy-service routing rules to prevent automatic re-roll to the hotfix tag.
deploy-bot: Deploy/rollback logs: https://redwood-infra/reports/deploy/1752000456 — contains rollout events, health checks, and revert artifacts.
sara: closing thread. we'll update release notes and the status page once postmortem is published.
